text:
Predicates:
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Stable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.
Question: 
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Imperium doesn't have a feud with a professional wrestling stable that includes Ivy Nile.
Premises:
Stable(DiamondMine) ∧ Member(CreedBrothers, DiamondMine) ∧ Member(IvyNile, DiamondMine) ∧ Leads(RoderickStrong, DiamondMine) ∧ Feud(Imperium, DiamondMine) ::: Diamond Mine is a professional wrestling stable, led by Roderick Strong, including the Creed Brothers and Ivy Nile, and Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
¬Feud(Imperium, x) ∧ Includes(x, IvyNile) ::: Imperium doesn't have a feud with any stable that includes Ivy Nile.
